basic_info.description: Timeless beauty meets modern luxury in this updated Miraloma Park gem! Open, airy and bathed in light, a spacious two-level layout invites you to unwind. Enter the living room with vaulted ceiling, gas fireplace and period details. Flow into the generous dining room and remodeled chef's kitchen, showcasing custom cabinetry, granite counters, high-end WOLF and SubZero appliances, and a sunny breakfast bar. Main level has two well-lit bedrooms and a chic remodeled full bath with double vanity. Downstairs, enjoy versatility with a large family room opening to the garden, a full kitchen, and a bonus room ideal for a home office. Two lower bedrooms, one en-suite, offer space for guests, playroom, gym. Enjoy comfort and peace of mind with a brand new roof in 2024, plus smart Nest thermostat, refinished hardwoods, and ample storage throughout. The landscaped garden with stone patio is your private oasis. 1-car garage with laundry. Friendly neighborhood only a few flat blocks to restaurants, Mollie Stone's, CVS, Starbucks. Easy access to highways, MUNI, BART, and all the amenities of Noe Valley, Sunset, West Portal, Glen Park, Castro, Stonestown Mall and more. Escape to nature at nearby Mt Davidson and Glen Canyon. Style, charm, space and location - this one checks all the boxes!
